text:
neha: Heads-up for folks arriving early to the Ferry Building meetup: anyone have quick grab-and-go recs? Want something thats walkable from Embarcadero BART, can feed 5-6, and has at least 2 vegan options.
sam: Blue Bottle is nearby for coffee and pastries but limited savory veg.
diego: Gott's has big sandwiches and a good veg burger, lines move fast if you order at the counter.
zoe: The farmers market stand (by the ferry entrance) does a vegan grain bowl thats great for carrying. Also has compostable boxes.
neha: Score. Priorities are speed + a place that takes cards (no cash). Any objections to Gott's + 1 farmer bowl for vegan folks?
sam: Works for me. If someone wants GF it's hit-or-miss at Gott's but they have lettuce wraps.
lunchbot: Quick poll: react :sandwich: for Gott's + bowls, :coffee: for coffee & pastries only. Poll closes in 2h.
diego: :sandwich:
zoe: :sandwich:
sam: :sandwich: (can grab extras)
neha: Ok final plan Gott's counter order + pick up a couple vegan bowls. I'll ping in the channel when I'm there. See you by the Embarcadero stairs at 11:45.
